verdict.rationale: AngelList documents board consent templates that generate individual consents and collect signatures on-platform ('Generate & Execute'), a 'Record Only' upload path for consents signed elsewhere, bulk e-sign for administrators, and Equity Blocks that boards pre-approve to cover standard grants. Stockholder approvals are never mentioned, and nothing shows a consent being linked to the specific transaction it authorizes; repurchase and conversion records only accept uploaded agreements. The update FAQ also points equity customers toward moving to other cap table providers, which casts doubt on whether the feature remains available. Missing for 10: stockholder approval/consent workflows, explicit linking of consents to the transactions they authorize, independent or hands-on corroboration, clarity on whether the equity product is still offered.
